0fc36d2552ad:
⚜️ On 8 November the Orthodox Church celebrates the Synaxis of the Holy Archangels Michael and Gabriel and of all the heavenly powers, so today I am showing you the Holy Archangels Michael and Gabriel in an icon on glass painted in our workshop (model: Savu Moga, Arpașu de Sus, 1890)
◘ This feast dates from the 5th century, beginning as the simple anniversary of the consecration of the church of Saint Michael the Archangel built at the Baths of Arcadius in Constantinople. Over time, the feast came to be dedicated to all the Holy Angels. The seven angels we celebrate are:
• Michael – translated as “the power of God”. He is the commander of the heavenly hosts and the first of the Holy Archangels; he carries the fiery sword, and his role is to guard the law of God and to overcome all who do not obey it. He is also the one who stopped the angels from falling from heaven, who defended the body of Moses and who brought the ten plagues upon Pharaoh's people. It is said that at the end of the age he will raise the dead and gather all nations to judgement.
• Gabriel is translated as “man of God”, being the archangel of the Annunciation. He carries no fiery sword, but the lily of undefiled joy. He was the first to speak the name of Jesus, the one who brought the great mystery of the Lord's incarnation, the news of the conception, and who gave Saint John the Baptist his name.
• Raphael is the healer of human infirmities
• Uriel is the enlightener of those in darkness
• Selaphiel is the one who prays for mankind
• Jegudiel is the glorifier of God and the strengthener of those who do good works
• Barachiel is the bringer of God's blessing upon the earth
◘ Happy name day to all who celebrate!

cc5eea562b79:
◘ 18 February marks 71 years since the departure from earthly life of the pillar of fire of Christian spirituality in the communist prisons, Valeriu Gafencu (whom Nicolae Steinhardt called “the Saint of the Prisons”)
◘ Valeriu Gafencu was born on 24 January 1921 in Sângerei, Bessarabia; he was one of the young intellectuals who died in the prisons of Romania's communist regime of those times
◘ In this icon painted on glass (ordered as a gift to a holy Church in western Romania), Saint Valeriu Gafencu is shown alongside the Holy Brâncoveanu Martyrs

• The holy martyr Valeriu Gafencu: “the pillar of fire of Christian spirituality in the communist prisons”, called by Nicolae Steinhardt “the Saint of the Prisons”

352863a150c7:
«The Dormition of the Mother of God» – 15 August

• We welcome the great Feast of «the Dormition of the Mother of God» with an icon painted on glass in our workshop for a holy Church.

• «The icon of «the Dormition of the Mother of God» has a rich and deep spiritual meaning, revealing for each of us. In it we can see the falling asleep, the burial, the resurrection and the ascension of the Mother of God, steps through which we too may pass. The icon of the scene of «the Dormition of the Mother of God» describes a lofty state of reverence of the whole Universe towards the All-holy Theotokos.» (Fr. Nicolai Boian)
